hook_context.set_task_cpu: Only for actual CPU change, after native class migration/rseq/mm-cid/perf work and before __set_task_cpu; task still reports old CPU. Caller pi/rq serialization remains. No migration gate removed.
hook_context.try_to_wake_up: Restricted notification after native on_cpu acquire wait, before selection in remote wake path; not emitted for every success or current/runnable shortcut. Separate success hook is at shared successful exit after proxy waiter activation, outside scoped pi_lock but under preempt guard; no sleep/lifetime extension is promised.
hook_context.sched_fork: Before __sched_fork and TASK_NEW assignment, so callbacks must not assume fresh scheduler fields initialized or child published. Native reset-on-fork and DL rejection remain; priority/class hooks are independently reviewed.
hook_context.wake_up_new_task/new_task_stats: First callback before pi_lock/state publication; stats callback under task rq lock after clock/util initialization and before native activation. Native ENQUEUE_INITIAL and pointer wake flags preserved.
hook_context.flush_task: Only captured TASK_DEAD, after native class task_dead and before stack/task-reference drops. rq lock already released. Callback must release its own state without retaining unowned task/stack pointers; native pre-clear state observation and membarrier/lifetime ordering preserved.
hook_context.tick_entry: Locked after rq clock update. See scheduler-event-history-review.json; native donor versus current accounting remains.
hook_context.schedule: After final proxy/donor selection, under rq lock, before rq->curr publication/context switch. Emitted even prev==next. Arguments are execution prev/next, while rq->donor may differ; no callback may silently corrupt the selected runnable state.
hook_context.sched_cpu_starting/dying: Starting after native core/rq/tick initialization. Dying after native vacated-rq diagnostics and server stops/unlock, before load folding/hrtick/core teardown. CPU-hotplug ordering remains native plus separate SCX server; no early task migration or new hotplug skip.
hook_context.account_irq: Current signature carries bool start. It is true precisely when neither native hardirq nor eligible non-ksoftirqd softirq delta branch ran, not a literal irq_enter versus irq_exit flag for every nesting/ksoftirqd case. Native irqtime_enabled guard, offset arithmetic, timestamp update and statistics sync remain unchanged. Callback may run in IRQ context and must not sleep.
hook_context.update_misfit_status: Default true; false skips native update including clearing stale misfit load for NULL/nonmisfit tasks. Callback receives possibly NULL p before native test, must handle it and maintain its chosen state. Suppression can affect balancing/availability; not read-only notification.
hook_context.update_cpu_capacity: Default native capacity is already floored to one before callback. Preserve that input contract, then floor zero output to one before storing rq/group/min/max and trace. Callback can still alter positive capacity; extreme/overflowing or nonsensical policy remains its responsibility. Native load computations divide by group capacity (update_sg_lb_stats, update_sg_wakeup_stats, calculate_imbalance), motivating guard. No arbitrary callback safety claim.
hook_context.place_entity: Final callback after vruntime/deadline stores; modifying only local vruntime pointer has no scheduling effect. See fair-selection-hooks-review.json; do not restore obsolete pre-placement site.
hook_context.build_perf_domains: Final site is early sched_is_eas_possible override, retaining native build_perf_domains. See topology-scope-review.json; ENERGY_MODEL is disabled in SDK so site not emitted there, shared registry remains.

security: Retain generic vendor scheduling source compatibility without Qualcomm device implementation. New capacity guard restores a concrete upstream arithmetic invariant with narrower restriction than removing the hook. Old dummy stubs explicitly removed upstream in ACK history stay absent.
